changes: Remove the chart-side index / color-flag column entirely: the sticky table header and every symbol row now start directly from 幣種, while watchlist-order sorting still remains available internally.

Move persistent TradingView-style color marking to the left/right floating sector watchlists. Each symbol now has its own small flag button beside the ticker; clicking it opens the same six-color palette with clear option.
Keep browser memory and optional Cloudflare Worker / R2 synchronization for marks. Colors stay attached to the symbol identity and survive refresh / reopen / sort changes.
Remove the top-dropdown 顏色排序 mode from the chart filter area. Main chart sorting is now independent from watchlist color grouping.

Add watchlist-side color concentration: within each floating list, marked symbols automatically group together in fixed red → orange → yellow → green → blue → purple order, then unmarked symbols follow their original watchlist order.
Preserve existing 4H charts, 1D indicators, CoinGlass / proxy levels, Telegram bells, sticky header, side jumps, and daily price / % coloring from v1.3.3.
